appraisal_events.evidence: ne reste pas là, je te dis, tu vas te mettre à tousser... la fumée fait mal à mon ami
appraisal_events.explanation: As the target of Saint-Loup's solicitous intervention, the narrator is staged as a valued friend worth protecting, the passive beneficiary of the same courteous act that elevates Saint-Loup.

status_effects.explanation: He is included as the cared-for friend in this small scene, marked out for protective attention rather than overlooked.
